evidence.heading: Information Collection

evidence.heading: Information Collection

evidence.quote: You are always free to decline/delete our cookies or similar technologies if your browser/device permits, although in that case you may not be able to use certain features on the Platform and you may be required to re-enter your password more frequently during a session.
evidence.heading: Cookies or Similar Technologies

evidence.quote: Additionally, you may encounter “cookies” or other similar technologies on certain pages of the Platform that are placed by third parties.
evidence.heading: Cookies or Similar Technologies

evidence.quote: for services related to communication, marketing, data and information storage, transmission, security, analytics, fraud detection, risk assessment and research
evidence.heading: Information Sharing and Disclosures

G2.rationale: PhonePe shares data for marketing and permits third parties to place cookies/tracking technologies on its platform, but only directs users to browser/device controls to delete cookies rather than providing its own first-party opt-out mechanism.

evidence.quote: to inform you about online and offline offers, products, services, and updates; customizing and improving your experience by marketing, presenting advertising, and offering tailored products and offers
evidence.heading: Purpose and Use of Information

evidence.quote: Note that such financial institutions or business partners, including lending partners, may pull your information from credit bureaus for eligibility determination and risk assessment
evidence.heading: Information Sharing and Disclosures

G3.rationale: PhonePe uses personal information for presenting targeted advertising/tailored offers without user controls for profiling, and third-party financial partners perform eligibility determination and risk assessment using credit data without describing human review or appeal options.

evidence.quote: To the extent applicable, we store Personal Information within India and retain it in accordance with applicable laws and for a period no longer than it is required for the purpose for which it was collected.
evidence.heading: Storage and Retention

G4.rationale: PhonePe only discloses general, purpose-based retention periods ('no longer than it is required for the purpose for which it was collected') rather than specifying concrete timeframes for account or user data.

evidence.quote: You can access and review your Personal Information shared by you by placing a request with us.
evidence.heading: Personal Information Access/Rectification and Consent

evidence.quote: In case you wish to delete your account or Personal Information, please use the ‘Help’ section of the PhonePe Platform.
evidence.heading: Personal Information Access/Rectification and Consent

evidence.quote: However, retention of your Personal Information will be subject to applicable laws.
evidence.heading: Personal Information Access/Rectification and Consent

G5.rationale: PhonePe provides rights to access and delete personal information, but specifies that retention remains subject to applicable laws and does not explicitly set out a self-contained right to correct data in the text body.

evidence.quote: to identify security breaches and attacks; investigating, preventing, and taking action on illegal or suspected fraud or money laundering activities and conducting forensic audits as part of internal or external audit or investigation by PhonePe or government agencies located within India or outside the Indian jurisdiction
evidence.heading: Purpose and Use of Information

evidence.quote: with the internal investigation department within PhonePe or agencies appointed by PhonePe for investigation purposes located within or outside the Indian jurisdiction
evidence.heading: Information Sharing and Disclosures

G6.rationale: PhonePe discloses potential data transfers or disclosures to agencies and government entities located outside the Indian jurisdiction, but names no specific transfer safeguards such as SCCs or adequacy decisions.

evidence.quote: We do not knowingly solicit or collect Personal Information from children under the age of 18 and use of our Platform is available only to persons who can form a legally binding contract under the Indian Contract Act, 1872.
evidence.heading: Children Information

evidence.heading: Children Information

G7.rationale: PhonePe applies an age threshold of 18, requiring minors under 18 to use the platform only under adult supervision.

DPDP1.rationale: PhonePe relies on browsewrap consent language ('By visiting, downloading, using PhonePe Platform... you expressly agree...').
